modules.title: 两个独立进程怎样隔离图片任务故障
进程边界怎样改变故障范围

items.title: 问题与关键机制
items.text: Web 请求和图片处理共用一个进程时，图片任务崩溃会拖停网站；把图片任务交给独立进程，通过队列或管道传递任务，让操作系统分别管理资源和退出状态，失败结果回到任务状态。

items.title: 验证故障边界
items.text: 模拟图片进程退出，Web 进程仍响应且任务能失败或重试，说明隔离有效；这不代表两个进程不需要通信和共享持久数据。

items.title: 代码编辑器也会划分进程
items.text: 代码编辑器把语言分析器放在独立进程；分析器崩溃时编辑器仍能保存文件，并可单独重启分析器。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 进程是正在运行的执行环境，不是磁盘上的程序文件，也不是整台机器。进程隔离能限制部分故障和内存影响，但跨进程通信、持久化和恢复仍要单独设计。

lessonPractice.title: 图片任务占用大量内存并偶尔崩溃，目前与 Web 请求运行在同一进程中。哪种改法最符合进程隔离？

options.label: 把图片任务交给独立进程，并分别记录两个 PID 和退出状态
options.feedback: 对。独立进程有自己的运行环境，图片进程退出后可以单独重启并检查 Web 进程是否仍在响应。

options.label: 把图片代码拆成另一个函数，但继续在同一进程里调用
options.feedback: 函数边界不会带来进程级资源隔离，未处理崩溃仍可能让同一进程退出。

options.label: 把同一个进程改名为 image-service，再继续同时处理 Web 请求
options.feedback: 名称不会改变运行边界；要查看实际进程 ID、内存和生命周期。

en.title: Image work uses lots of memory and sometimes crashes inside the web process. Which change creates process isolation?

options.label: Run image work in a separate process and record both PIDs and exit states
options.feedback: Correct. The image process can exit and restart independently while the web process is checked for continued service.

options.label: Move image code to another function but call it in the same process
options.feedback: A function boundary does not isolate process resources or lifecycle.

options.label: Rename the same process image-service while it still handles web requests
options.feedback: A name does not create a runtime boundary; inspect PIDs, memory, and lifecycle.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把图片处理任务放到独立进程，通过队列或管道接收任务。记录 Web 进程和图片进程各自的 PID、内存和退出状态；模拟图片进程崩溃，确认 Web 请求仍能响应，图片任务能被明确标为失败或重试。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Move image processing into a separate process that receives work through a queue or pipe. Record the web and image PIDs, memory, and exit states. Crash the image process and verify web requests still work while the image job becomes visibly failed or retryable.

learning.assumes: You know a service keeps running in the operating system after it starts.
learning.outcome: You can use process IDs and memory isolation to identify separate processes and verify whether one keeps working after another exits.

modules.title: How separate processes isolate an image-worker failure
How a process boundary changes failure scope

items.title: Problem and key mechanism
items.text: When web requests and image work share one process, an image-worker crash can stop the site; send image jobs to a separate process through a queue or pipe so the OS manages resources and exit states separately and the failure returns to job status.

items.title: Verify the failure boundary
items.text: Crash the image process and confirm the web process still responds while the job fails or retries. Communication and durable state still need design.

items.title: Code editors also separate processes
items.text: A code editor can run its language analyzer in a separate process. If the analyzer crashes, the editor can still save files and restart only the analyzer.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A process is a running execution environment, not a program file or an entire machine. Isolation can limit crashes and memory impact, but inter-process communication, persistence, and recovery remain separate concerns.

distinctions.label: Thread
distinctions.text: A {c:process} is the isolated OS resource allocation unit; a {c:thread} is an execution unit inside a process sharing its memory space.
